title: Miami Nightlife This Week, Weirdest First
igCaption:
Ice-skating under palms is on the nightlife calendar this week.
Nov. 9 to 13, Miami, free to $298

Sources: Miami New Times

#MiamiEvents #MiamiNightlife #ThingsToDoMiami #SouthFloridaEvents

scenes.text: Miami this week has real ice-skating under palm trees, salsa on the river, and Common with an orchestra.

NightGarden opens Thursday at Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden on Old Cutler Road. The new piece this season is real ice-skating under the palms. It runs from six to ten p.m., with light installations, a laser show at the Tree of Life, and Archimedes the talking tree.

scenes.text: Good Night John Boy opened Friday in Fort Lauderdale at 270 SE Sixth Avenue. The bar takes over the former Howl at the Moon space, with 1970s decor, nightly DJs, and Disco Punch served in a take-home disco cup.

scenes.text: Nu Deco Ensemble plays with Common on Thursday at the Adrienne Arsht Center. Sam Hyken conducts the show, which reworks Common’s catalog with hip-hop, orchestral sounds, and cinematic songwriting. Tickets run from seventy dollars to two hundred ninety-eight dollars. If you go, open NEAR and see who else is at Arsht.

scenes.text: Viva Salsa Mondays happens at Elia on the River, at fourteen forty Northwest North River Drive. Eleonor and her band play live salsa and Latin beats on the Miami River. It starts at seven p.m., and admission is free with RSVP.
